title: A correction replaces the earlier fact
checks: After the person corrects a fact, the new value is recalled in a later conversation and the old one is not.
why: Stale memory is worse than none: the assistant confidently repeats what the person already said was wrong.

case.name: A correction replaces the earlier fact
case.about: {{new_fact_word}} replaces {{fact_word}} after a correction, also in a new conversation.

reply.reference: Answers {{new_fact_word}}; {{fact_word}} is not given as the current answer.
rubric: Doesn't give {{fact_word}} as the current answer
